summary: Frontend-only verification of DynoPay: (1) landing stability across mobile/tablet/desktop; (2) transactions status badges (row/card/modal + dark mode + tooltip + no horizontal overflow); (3) wallets page read-only checks of edit/add flows. transactions_desktop_1440x900.tooltip_text_on_hover: The buyer opened the checkout but has not paid yet.

critical_code_review_comments: MINOR/PORTAL: `[data-testid="add-wallet-dialog"]` (and likely `edit-wallet-dialog`) renders with TWO elements in the DOM simultaneously — one with `visibility: hidden` and one with `visibility: visible` (both display:block, both fully-sized 447x613). This trips strict Playwright locators and can hurt a11y (screen readers may announce the hidden clone). Likely caused by keeping a mounted MUI Drawer / a duplicate portal target with SSR + hydration. Consider unmounting when closed or using a single portal instance.

MINOR: On the earlier run on /wallet a lingering `edit-wallet-dialog` DOM node remained after clicking Cancel (query returned non-null even though visually closed). Same portal/mount-cleanup concern as above. Wallet list length was unchanged so no functional impact.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three review-request fixes verified on preview URL. SSR font-vars <style> is properly emitted via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (no " / '). Transaction status badges use TransactionStatusBadge with tx-row-status / tx-card-status / tx-modal-status testids. Wallet edit/add icons have aria-labels + testids and Lucide SVGs render at 14-18px. Edit flow correctly switches submit label to 'Verify & save' and shows the OTP helper on address change. NOTE for next agent: two portal instances of add-wallet-dialog / edit-wallet-dialog exist in the DOM (one hidden) — always use `getComputedStyle(el).visibility==='visible'` filter when asserting content, and prefer native input value setter + dispatchEvent('input', bubbles:true) over page.keyboard.type() for MUI text fields inside dialogs (keyboard.type occasionally failed to trigger React onChange in this app).
